card.name: Anaphylaxis warnings in enzyme therapy labels
card.fires_on: The comma after "anaphylaxis) occurs" and the word "a" in "in a healthcare setting", in boxed warnings of enzyme replacement therapy labels.

modes.label: Comma after reaction occurs
modes.description: The comma that ends the clause "If a severe hypersensitivity reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) occurs" just before the instruction to stop the drug.
modes.example: the supervision of a healthcare provider with appropriate medical monitoring and support measures. If a severe hypersensitivity reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) occurs<<,>> discontinue STRENSIQ and immediately

modes.label: "a" before healthcare setting
modes.description: The article "a" after "administered in" or "Initiate [drug] in", just before "healthcare setting".
modes.example: Initiate CEREZYME in<< a>> healthcare setting with appropriate medical monitoring and support

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest on-the-spot, in-session settings, but the output effect is weak and mostly Chinese.
card.plain: It fires at the small words that lead into "give this infusion in a healthcare setting" or "if anaphylaxis occurs, stop" in enzyme drug warnings.
